_provenance.method: Linux builds as shipped: each carries only its own host and platform binaries (packaging prunes foreign @gpuix/native-* packages; webview/CEF carry no GPUIX).

_provenance.note: The benchmarked binaries were built before pruning existed (GPUIX 200 MiB, webview 177 MiB, CEF 537 MiB embedded unused npm payload); payload size does not change resident memory measurably.
